# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.1.0 · Mac 3.1.0

Web **2.1.0** adds **bookkeeping** (Money / 记账 / Finanzen) and a calmer design across Today, Timeline, Long-range and Review. Mac app **3.1.0** bundles the same web assets. All fixes from 2.0.11 / Mac 3.0.5 are included.

## Highlights

- **Money page:** quick entry, budgets, grouped categories, German bank CSV/PDF-to-CSV import with duplicate and transfer detection, Today *Spending today*, and monthly Review spending.
- **Categories → entries:** pick a category in the chart and the list shows exactly its entries with count and total.
- **Calm entry list:** one date line per day, filters behind one button, tap an entry to edit or delete it.
- **Subscriptions & fixed costs:** open one to see who gets paid, the account, the next payment, the yearly total and every payment from your statements. Likely subscriptions are suggested from imported statements.
- **Settings:** one grouped list instead of scattered panels.
- **Design:** hairline illustrations on every page header, light/dark, scroll-in and hover motion, quieter cards.
